resolved_findings.resolution: Preview now emits revision metadata only when Value::as_u64 succeeds and the value is positive; other JSON shapes produce null. The regression covers generic writes and named creates for string/object/array/bool/negative values, and preserves a valid revision.

Login account projection screens both the issued session value and private device proof. Reflection in id/email/display_name is rejected before persistence and follows candidate cleanup/revocation. Status still screens its active credential.

Logout removes the selected secret before clearing locator metadata. Failed removal retains the locator for retry; missing-secret recovery retries idempotent removal and metadata cleanup without falsely claiming remote revocation. External environment credentials retain source-aware behavior. The existing configuration concurrency guard preserves concurrent new connections.

The helper now resolves exact version refs to a commit, including bounded annotated-tag dereferencing/cycle rejection, and rejects mismatches. It creates only a missing tag through POST, validates before draft staging, uses --verify-tag, rechecks main plus tag immediately before draft publication, and leaves mismatched staging as an unpublished draft.
